blocks.text: Zscaler organizes DNS requests and responses into a hierarchy of categories for granular filtering and policy creation. There are predefined super categories that are divided into specific categories.
Zscaler provides a set of immutable test FQDNs for DNS request categories and DNS tunnels and network apps that you can use to validate your DNS Control policies.
These test domains resolve to Google. You might encounter errors when accessing these FQDNs through a browser.
